description: Defines a singleton class 'HeartbeatStore' that manages and observes heartbeat events, decoding them from notifications and asynchronously fetching the latest heartbeat if not already available.

classes.name: HeartbeatStore
classes.description: A singleton class that observes heartbeat notifications, decodes events, and maintains the latest heartbeat event.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Private initializer that sets up a notification observer and asynchronously fetches the last heartbeat event if not already set.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Destructor that removes the notification observer upon deallocation.
